quote: Starting profile II II 10 pulses (for ESA which shall be operational during engine start phases) C (for other ESA)
text: The immunity of an ESA to transient disturbances conducted along supply lines shall meet, for the starting profile on a 12 V system, immunity test level II and 10 pulses, with functional status classification B for functions related to immunity related functions for an ESA which shall be operational during engine start phases and C for other ESA, and functional status classification D for functions not related to immunity related functions (Table 3a). Starting profile is only applicable to ESAs that could be installed in vehicles with internal combustion engines which are started with a 12V/24V starter motor.
